records.definition: The highest governing body. Holds ultimate accountability and delegates authority downward.
A committee of the board, constituted by the board and reporting directly to it.
A committee of senior management with delegated decision-making authority.
A committee taking decisions within an operating group or business.
A standing body that coordinates across areas. Usually advisory rather than decision-making.
A body that monitors and challenges an activity without owning it.
A time-limited group formed to deliver a specific outcome, then disbanded.
A body that provides expertise and recommendations but holds no decision rights.
